description: Source code for a utility that handles SEAMA files, including packing, sealing, dumping, and extracting images with associated metadata. Implements file verification, checksum calculation, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: verbose
methods.description: Prints formatted verbose output if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: cleanup_exit
methods.description: Prints exit message and terminates the program with given exit code.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set program options.

methods.name: calculate_digest
methods.description: Calculates MD5 digest of a file segment.

methods.name: copy_file
methods.description: Copies data from one file to another.

methods.name: verify_seama
methods.description: Verifies SEAMA file integrity and checksum.

methods.name: write_seama_header
methods.description: Writes SEAMA header with metadata and size.

methods.name: write_meta_data
methods.description: Writes metadata entries to a SEAMA file.

methods.name: dump_seama
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about a SEAMA file.

methods.name: seal_files
methods.description: Creates a SEAMA file sealing multiple images.

methods.name: pack_files
methods.description: Creates individual SEAMA files from input images.

methods.name: match_meta
methods.description: Checks if metadata matches specified criteria.

methods.name: extract_file
methods.description: Extracts an image from SEAMA files based on metadata.
